title: A statement handed to a writer, checked by a review
description: A lender's servicing desk sends the annual statement of a loan. Writing it is handed to a writer and checked by the statement review against the loan book; the program above the desk has a judge check the servicing lead's account of the month. One look hands the statement over (try 1) and waits; the account waits on the statement. This case is that one look; the recorded sequence learn_checks shows the review's rows on three tries and the judge's verdict, and what the learn feature reads of them.
